1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 1) covers general requirements for steel wire ropes for hauling and carrying-hauling purpose in aerial ropeways.
Most common rope constructions and rope types are given in Table 1 to Table 7. Common rope grades, cores and size ranges are identified by 'Ã—' mark however, other sizes, intermediate grades (up to including 1 960 grade) and core may be supplied as agreed between manufacturer and purchaser.
Specially developed constructions may be supplied to fulfil specific requirement of purchaser table given below.
